tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.title: MACtion: Ohio @ Akron
games.matchup: Ohio Bobcats (6-2, 4-0 MAC) @ Akron Zips (1-7, 0-4 MAC)
games.take: The MAC's only unbeaten conference team visits its only winless one, and the market has priced that gap honestly: no US price beats the devigged Pinnacle fair on either side, spread, or total. Ohio's Nick Poulos is back healthy and efficient since returning from injury, while Akron's Brayden Roggow leads the MAC in interceptions and the Zips are without RB Chris Gee. Weather is a non-factor — clear, ~65°F at kickoff in Akron with a light SSE wind and no alerts. No true edge here, but the lean is Ohio on the moneyline because -600 (BetMGM) is the closest price to fair, at about -0.8% EV, while every Akron price is far worse.
games.verdict: LEAN: Ohio — no true edge, but the lean is Ohio because -600 is the closest price to fair.
games.weather: Clear, ~65°F at kickoff, SSE wind ~6 mph; no NWS alerts

games.title: MACtion: Buffalo @ Miami (OH)
games.matchup: Buffalo Bulls (5-3, 3-1 MAC) @ Miami (OH) RedHawks (5-3, 3-1 MAC)
games.venue: Fred C. Yager Stadium, Oxford, OH
games.market: Miami (OH) -6, total 44.5 (consensus; spread -6 to -6.5 across books)
games.our_fair: Miami (OH) 67.2% / Buffalo 32.8% (devigged Pinnacle fair, moneyline); spread fair Buffalo +6 51.2%
games.take: The consequential game of the night: both teams are 3-1 in the MAC, both on three-game winning streaks, and the loser takes real damage in the MAC race. Miami is down to its third quarterback in Caleb Heavner and leans on a run defense that has held four straight opponents under three yards per carry; Buffalo leans on Messiah Burch, who has topped 100 rushing yards in five straight games. The market has this one right too — no US price clears the 0.75% bar. No true edge here, but the lean is Buffalo +6 because, against a 51.2% Pinnacle spread fair, -108 is the least-bad number on the board, and five of Miami's last six games have been decided by four points or fewer.
games.verdict: LEAN: Buffalo +6 — no true edge, but the lean is Buffalo because +6 is the closest price to fair.
games.weather: Partly cloudy, ~68°F at kickoff, SSE wind 8-9 mph; no NWS alerts, rain after midnight
